title: Core palette
text: Use midnight navy, sky blue, warm cream, and coral; other colors remain small supporting accents.

title: Coral hierarchy
text: Coral is an accent and must not dominate the main subject or background.

title: Flat modular construction
text: Use crisp flat fills and rounded modular forms. Subtle antialiasing and minor tonal variation are acceptable; decorative or volumetric gradients, photorealistic textures, bevels, gloss, and cast shadows are not.

title: Action clarity
text: Body direction, gaze, hands, weight, and prop contact must make the requested action clearly readable.

title: Exact campaign wording
text: Requested visible copy must be reproduced verbatim and legibly on the specified object.
